title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B UD-IQ2_XXS — upstream shard provenance verification
author: LLM Bridge
scope: Compares the locally measured per-shard SHA-256 digests and byte sizes against the authoritative published metadata at a pinned Hugging Face revision. No shard was re-hashed or re-downloaded; the 64 GB model was not touched. Upstream metadata was read via the public HF tree API.

upstream.publisher: unsloth (GGUF quantization publisher; distinct from the NVIDIA base-model publisher)
upstream.sha256_field: lfs.oid (64-hex SHA-256); NOT the top-level git-blob SHA-1 oid and NOT the Xet xetHash

result: ALL THREE SHARDS MATCH — filename, exact byte size, and SHA-256 all equal the published Unsloth files at the pinned revision.
trust_assumptions: The match proves the previously measured file contents equal the publisher's recorded object at this revision, subject to the validity of the stored local SHA-256 and the upstream metadata.
It does NOT prove an arbitrarily modified local file is still unchanged; runtime authenticated-range verification in the reader is preserved and unchanged.
'unsloth' is the GGUF quantization publisher; this provenance is for that artifact, not a direct attestation by the NVIDIA base-model publisher.
The local SHA-256 digests were measured in a prior round by a single streamed pass (benchmarks/evidence/nemotron_latentmoe_mamba_block_2026-11-25.json); the shards were not re-hashed here.
final_status: COMPLETE for Part I (provenance) — local digests and sizes match the authoritative published metadata at revision 5c8f6a6ddc080c2adde51f07fe2645ceeef54dde.
